headline: Across 77 transactions on four cards, the documented rates, exclusions, and round-down rule give exactly the ten gold disputes; the only gap is the rounding doc missing from the required list.

issues.summary: The floor-rounding rule that makes the gold dispute set exact (doc_credit_cards_credit_cards_(general)_007) is not in this task's required_documents, so the golden_retrieval variant never shows it.
evidence: task_022.required_documents does not include doc_credit_cards_credit_cards_(general)_007 (grep: only task_028 lists it)
src/tau2/domains/banking_knowledge/retrieval.py build_tools: "# No retrieval tools (no_knowledge, full_kb, golden_retrieval)"

doc_credit_cards_credit_cards_(general)_007: "All credit card rewards points are rounded down to the nearest whole number. When calculating points earned on a purchase, the system always truncates (floors) fractional points rather than rounding to the nearest integer."
issues.why_it_matters: Under golden_retrieval the agent cannot search the KB, so it must guess the rounding convention; round-half-up flags 26 extra transactions (e.g. txn_1c63bf5307a1 Diamond $487.50x5 = 2437.5 -> 2438 vs stored 2437). Search-based configs (default alltools, bm25, etc.) can retrieve doc_007, so headline scores are unaffected.

solution_check: Computed all 77 rows for f9bf8de0be: Diamond 5%; Business Platinum 4% Travel/Software/Media else 1.5%; Business Silver 10% Travel/Software else 1%, with Apple/Microsoft/Dell/etc. excluded (doc_..._business_silver_rewards_card_005); EcoCard 5/$ Green except Target/Walmart/Amazon/ThredUp. The account opened 06/10/2024, before the double-cash promo window, so no promo. Under floor the mismatches are exactly the gold ten, e.g. ffeede Dell 1849.99 -> 1849 vs 18499, ba8b47 "Target - Eco Collection" 145.67x1 = 145 vs 728, 4f5e24 ThredUp 78 vs 391, 1a4918 Facebook Ads 875.33x4 = 3501 vs 8753, 508e27 Google Ads 1250x4 = 5000 vs 1875. Round-half-up adds 26 false positives.
prior_note: Prior (Major) said the rounding convention was undocumented; doc_credit_cards_credit_cards_(general)_007 states floor rounding, is unchanged since v1.0.0, and reproduces the gold exactly, so that defect never applied to search-based configs. Only the required_documents omission remains.
notes: "Target - Eco Collection" requires matching the excluded merchant by prefix; doc_..._ecocard_004 says "Buying eco-labeled or 'sustainable' items from the excluded general retailers still earns the standard rate", which covers it. Business Platinum has no merchant-exclusion list, so Microsoft 365 there earns 4% (599 = floor(599.96), consistent). get_credit_card_transactions_by_user returns every row with no truncation (query_database_tool).
